result.reason: The operative language fully implements the preferred position: it creates a mutual cap using the required greater-of formula, retains mutual indirect and consequential damages exclusions, includes every required uncapped carve-out, and excludes Customer payment obligations from damages for cap purposes. It does not independently satisfy the fallback's exact 12-month-fees cap because the USD 1,000,000 floor may produce a higher cap. The revision is otherwise discrete and leaves the existing Section 13/14 carve-out and unrelated terms intact.
